summary: [spec fidelity] The When is GET /api/briefs, but the bound bun tests render hand-built Brief objects and never call the API or dashboard_briefs.rs. By hand on a live `canon dashboard`: /api/briefs returned counts, language ko detected and advisories with message=excerpt and the matched value in hint; the page showed '27 advisories in 1 of 2 briefs.', 8 rule groups with counts, and no badge on the clean brief.
